title: Validate a device record
hints: Three passes over the record: missing required fields, then per-field checks for fields that are present, then unknown keys. Append to one `errors` list; never return early.
Write each rule as a small function that returns a bool and never raises: isinstance first, then the content test. For dates, try date.fromisoformat inside try/except ValueError.
isinstance(True, int) is True, so ram_gb needs `not isinstance(v, bool)`. Build messages with f"...got {value!r}" so strings are quoted and numbers are not.
